# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues in the MLED-1 firmware privately through GitHub:
open the **Security** tab of this repository and choose **Report a vulnerability**.
Please don't open a public issue or post details on Discord first.

We aim to acknowledge reports within a few working days and will keep you updated
until a fix ships.

## Scope

- Supported: the latest MLED-1 release and the `main` branch.
- The open setup hotspot ("Apollo MLED-1 Hotspot", no password) is intentional: it is
  only active until the device joins your Wi-Fi. Reports about what it allows while
  active are still welcome.
- MLED-1 is based on [WLED](https://github.com/wled/WLED). If an issue also affects stock
  WLED, tell us in your report and we will coordinate with the WLED maintainers.
